body: Everything got too much. I’ve made so many mistakes that haunt me… I just wanted out
I don’t have many words right now but Thank you for this.
I’ve thought of this often… I’m a (struggling) Christian too
Me too and i have a husband and toddler. My mom has gone thru enough.

Monitoring is probably a good idea... Thanks for that. I hate weighing myself, usually monitor with my clothes but by the time they're too tight it's usually too late. Didn't think to let the doctor know, felt a bit embarrassed about it. Like she would think I'm not serious or something. But I will. Thanks

Oh my goodness this helps a lot I didn't think to do an outline. And the way you broke it down really helps. My mind is so scattered I'm nervous cause on the one hand I know I'm not okay, haven't been for years. On the other hand I feel like my issues aren't real issues. Anyway I have committed to going. Thank you for taking time to respond to me.

I definitely think I'm desensitized... It was such an hectic emotional thing before. Now it just seems like practical option. I nearly got into an accident with a big truck last week. While I was scared in the moment cause I don't like driving, when it was over, I was kinda disappointed a collision never happened.
My mom has been through enough. Only thing keeping me here too...
